app.title: Street Situation
app.tagline: What's happening right now at any street, junction or area: traffic, incidents, weather and public cameras.

search.placeholder: Type a street, address, junction or area, e.g. Jaffa Street, Jerusalem
search.label: Search for a place
search.noResults: No places found for “{query}”. Try adding a city name.
search.error: Search is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.

map.label: Map
map.hint: Click anywhere on the map to choose a location.

empty.title: Choose a place to get a situation report
empty.body: Search for a street or address, or click on the map. You will see traffic, incidents and weather from the configured sources, plus nearby public cameras where their terms allow it.
empty.tripTitle: Plan a trip to see the road ahead
empty.tripBody: Enter where you are leaving from and where you are going. You will get the route and travel time, traffic and incidents on the way, the weather along the route for when you will be there, places to stop, and parking at the destination.

report.error: Could not build the situation report. Please try again.

section.notConfigured: No data from this source: no provider is configured.
section.notConfiguredHint: Self-hosters can enable one in .env (see the README).
section.error: The data source is unavailable right now.
section.noData: The provider returned no data for this location.

summary.title: Summary
summary.generating: Writing an AI summary from the collected data…
summary.notConfigured: AI summary is off: no AI provider is configured on this server.
summary.notConfiguredHint: Set OLLAMA_URL (local, free) or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to enable it.
summary.error: The AI summary could not be generated right now.
summary.generatedBy: Generated by {provider} ({model}) from the data below. AI can make mistakes.
summary.basedOnCamera: Includes an analysis of the image from: {camera}

cameras.title: Cameras
cameras.none: No verified public cameras within {radius}. The report uses the other sources.
cameras.linkOnlyExplain: The terms of this source do not clearly allow showing its image here, so we only link to it.
cameras.imageError: The camera image is unavailable right now.
cameras.analysisNotAllowed: AI analysis is not permitted for this camera.
cameras.analysisDisclaimer: Observed in the image only. Uncertainty: {level}.

sources.title: Sources and attribution
sources.privacy: No accounts, no tracking, no analytics. Camera images are never stored.

parking.title: Parking
parking.none: No public parking found within {radius} in OpenStreetMap.
parking.noOccupancy: No live occupancy data: OpenStreetMap describes where parking is, its size and fees, not how full it is right now.

mode.label: What do you want to see?

trip.fillBoth: Enter both a starting point and a destination.
trip.samePlace: The starting point and the destination are the same place.
trip.loading: Planning the route and collecting data along the way…
trip.error: Could not plan this trip. Please try again.
trip.tooFar: This trip is longer than the server allows.
trip.title: {from} → {to}
trip.withoutTraffic: Free-flow estimate: no live traffic data (add a TomTom key for traffic-aware times)
trip.weatherHint: For the time you are expected at each point. Values marked “forecast” are from the hourly forecast.
trip.trafficSections: {count} slow sections, {minutes} min of delay in total
trip.trafficClear: No slow sections reported along the route.
trip.trafficSampled: Flow sampled at {count} points along the route.
trip.incidentsNone: No active incidents reported along the route.
trip.incidentsCount: {count} incidents within 1 km of the route
trip.stopsLoading: Looking for fuel stations and rest areas along the route…
trip.stopsNone: No fuel stations or rest areas found within 400 m of the route in OpenStreetMap.
trip.generating: Writing a trip briefing from the collected data…

missing.parking: No parking data at the destination
